Physically elevates mountain ranges and: Physically elevates mountain ranges and gently recesses deep ocean basins in 3D on both the globe and flat map. Paper mode always stays flat. Disable for a completely smooth sphere and lower GPU vertex load. Changes immediately.
How the 3D map scales when rendered belo: How the 3D map scales when rendered below native resolution. Auto uses FSR 1.0 below 100% scale on Vulkan; FSR 2.2 adds temporal reconstruction on Vulkan; Bilinear is used on Compatibility or when selected. Changes immediately.
Edge sharpening filter strength for FSR: Edge sharpening filter strength for FSR 1.0 and FSR 2.2 upscaling (0 is sharpest, 2 is softest). Changes immediately.
